SPY-Stocks.02 L2: Custom Bins: 20 bins (coarser) with Blue fill; same daily return data as L1 — fewer bars, wider bin width ~0.21%

QQQ-Stocks.01 L1: Basic: 50-bin daily return histogram; wider spread than SPY (bin_width=0.0012 vs 0.0009) reflecting higher QQQ volatility
QQQ-Stocks.02 L2: Custom Bins: 20 bins, Blue fill; coarser view of QQQ returns, bin_width ~0.30% — wider than SPY's 0.21%
QQQ-Stocks.03 L3: Bin Width: Fixed 0.5% bin width; PercentFormat dp=1; QQQ's wider range fills more bins than SPY/DIA
QQQ-Stocks.04 L4: Analytics: 40 bins with analytics overlay; Blue fill opacity=0.6; PercentFormat dp=2; mean and std lines visible
QQQ-Stocks.05 L5: Reference Lines: 40 bins with Zero vertical reference; PercentFormat dp=2; QQQ shows more positive-skewed distribution than SPY
QQQ-Stocks.06 L6: Percent Format: Intraday range distribution; 30 bins, Indigo fill; QQQ ranges wider (bin_width ~0.11%) than DIA's 0.07%
QQQ-Stocks.07 L7: Fill Styling: 60-bin log returns; Blue opacity=0.5 with analytics; bin_width ~0.0010 — wider than SPY reflecting higher vol
QQQ-Stocks.08 L8: Plot Bands: 30 bins with Low Freq and High Freq y-bands; QQQ has more observations in the tail bands than SPY/DIA

DIA-Stocks.01 L1: Basic: 50-bin daily return histogram; narrowest spread of the 3 (bin_width=0.0008) — DIA is the least volatile
DIA-Stocks.02 L2: Custom Bins: 20 bins, Blue fill; bin_width ~0.21% — similar to SPY, much narrower than QQQ
DIA-Stocks.03 L3: Bin Width: Fixed 0.5% bin width; PercentFormat dp=1; tightest distribution — most mass concentrated in center bins
DIA-Stocks.04 L4: Analytics: 40 bins with analytics; Blue fill opacity=0.6; PercentFormat dp=2; narrower std lines than SPY/QQQ
DIA-Stocks.05 L5: Reference Lines: 40 bins with Zero vertical reference; PercentFormat dp=2; DIA slightly right of zero, tighter tails
DIA-Stocks.06 L6: Percent Format: Intraday range distribution; 30 bins, Indigo fill; narrowest of all 3 (bin_width ~0.075%), most days under 1%
DIA-Stocks.07 L7: Fill Styling: 60-bin log returns; Blue opacity=0.5 with analytics; smallest bin_width (0.0007) — DIA tightest distribution
DIA-Stocks.08 L8: Plot Bands: 30 bins with Low Freq and High Freq y-bands; DIA has highest peak frequency — most concentrated around zero
